STATE VS. PETRI - WITNESS STATEMENT
S-01

I swear to tell the truth, the whole truth, and nothing but the truth.

Today, the 12th of last month, I observed the defendant near the scene of the incident.
According to my recollection, I saw the defendant walking in the direction of the victim's
location. The weather was clear with good visibility.

I have no personal relationship with any party to this case.

Signed: Witness A
Date: October 12

STATE VS. PETRI - WITNESS STATEMENT (ATTORNEY ONLY)
S-03

CONFIDENTIAL - DO NOT CIRCULATE OUTSIDE COUNSEL

This statement contains details regarding the defendant's prior criminal record which may be
admissible for impeachment purposes only. The information was obtained through routine 
background check procedures conducted prior to trial preparation.

Defendant Petri has a history of similar charges from previous jurisdiction. These records
were discovered during the standard pre-tr discovery process.

This information is subject to the protection outlined in the manifest and should only be
accessed by authorized counsel.

Signed: Witness C
Date: October 9

STATE VS. PETRI - WITNESS STATEMENT
S-02

I declare under penalty of perjury that the following is true and correct to the best of my knowledge.

On the evening of October 10th, I was returning home from work when I noticed unusual activity
near the block where the incident occurred. Two individuals were seen moving fast. One matched
the physical description of the defendant provided by police.

I did not hear any verbal exchange between the individuals. My distance from the scene was
approximately 30 feet.

I remain available for further questions by legal counsel.

Signed: Witness B
Date: October 11
